TikTok.primary_goal: stop the scroll, maximize completion, comments and shares
TikTok.hook: a bold curiosity gap, surprising mistake, strong contrast or immediate consequence
TikTok.pacing: very fast; introduce a visual or information change every 2-3 seconds
TikTok.ending: finish with a short opinion question or practical challenge

YouTube Shorts.primary_goal: maximize engaged views, completion, rewatches and subscriber conversion
YouTube Shorts.hook: open with the payoff tension immediately, but do not reveal the answer
YouTube Shorts.pacing: fast and clear; one idea per short with a reveal every 3-5 seconds
YouTube Shorts.ending: deliver a satisfying payoff, then one natural question or follow-up tease

X.primary_goal: make the point understandable instantly and encourage replies or reposts
X.hook: state the surprising claim or tension in the first sentence
X.ending: end with a concise question that invites a response

Facebook Reels.primary_goal: maximize watch-through, shares and useful takeaways
Facebook Reels.hook: start with a relatable problem, warning, surprise or practical benefit
Facebook Reels.pacing: clear and energetic; keep captions easy to read and avoid overloading the viewer
Facebook Reels.ending: finish with a useful takeaway and a share-friendly question
